A scraper could be configured like
  this <product links selector> -> [<title selector>, <price selector>]. In this
  case, the product links selector is a parent selector and title and price

website_state_setup_deleteConfirmation.description: Confirmation dialog title shown when deleting a Website State Setup, which is a configuration that sets up a predefined state of the website before data extraction starts, such as logging in or applying a filter.

wizard_accessWizardSitemaps.description: A feature bullet in the info card promoting the Advanced Sitemap builder, about accessing sitemaps created with the wizard.

wizard_addImages.description: a button that allows to create more data selectors by clicking on image elements within the page

wizard_addMoreText.description: a button that allows to create more data selectors by clicking on data elements within the page

wizard_analyzingPageContent.description: Heading shown while the wizard is analyzing the page content.

wizard_analyzingUrlsWithAi.description: Status heading shown while AI analyzes the collected URLs; the count is a plural and the wait time is in seconds.

wizard_andMore.description: The last item in the wizard card's feature list, indicating there are additional features.

wizard_areMoreItemsLoadedAfterScrolling.description: Title of the card asking whether more items load after scrolling (infinite scroll).
wizard_areMoreItemsLoadedAfterScrolling.message: Are more items loaded after scrolling?

wizard_automateExtractionInCloud.description: Heading on the finish view promoting automated extraction in Web Scraper Cloud.

wizard_automateInCloud.description: Button that sets up the scrape to run automatically in Web Scraper Cloud.

wizard_botDetectionHandling.description: Web Scraper Cloud Feature List. Cloud can extract data from websites that use bot detection mechanisms.

wizard_checkingInfiniteScroll.description: Status text shown while the wizard checks whether the page has infinite scroll.

wizard_columnName.description: Form input placeholder for the name of a data column in the results table.

wizard_continueButton.description: Button that advances the wizard to the next step.

wizard_customizableCssSelectors.description: A feature list item in the wizard card promoting the Advanced Sitemap Builder; refers to CSS selectors.

wizard_customizableSiteNavigation.description: A feature bullet in the info card promoting the Advanced Sitemap builder.

wizard_dataExtractionError.description: Heading and error message shown when the wizard fails to extract data from the page.
wizard_dataExtractionError.message: An error occurred while extracting data from this page. The issue has been reported. Try again later.

wizard_dataPointsFoundMultiple.description: Heading showing how many data points were found on the page; the number is a plural.

wizard_dataPointsFoundSingle.description: Heading shown when a single data point was found on the page.

wizard_doesPageHavePagination.description: Title of the card asking whether the page has pagination.

wizard_doneSelecting.description: Button that finishes the point-and-click element selection.

wizard_enableInfiniteScroll.description: Button that turns on infinite scroll handling.

wizard_enableNavigationToItemPages.description: Heading describing enabling navigation to item pages and extracting data from each one.
wizard_enableNavigationToItemPages.message: Enable navigation to item pages and data extraction from each page.

wizard_errorTitle.description: Title of an error alert box.

wizard_gatheringPageData.description: Progress heading shown while gathering data from item pages; the numbers are the current page and total, e.g. 'Gathering page data 1 / 5'.

wizard_giveFeedback.description: A button that opens feedback form.

wizard_goToAdvancedSitemapBuilder.description: Title of an info card in the Sitemap Wizard that promotes switching to the classic Advanced Sitemap builder.

wizard_haveSomeThoughts.description: Heading of the AI feedback modal inviting the user to share thoughts.

wizard_howWasYourScrapingExperience.description: Heading on the wizard finish view asking the user to rate their scraping experience.

wizard_itemPageLinksMultiple.description: Heading showing how many item page links were selected; the number is a plural count, e.g. '3 item page links selected'.

wizard_itemPageLinksSingle.description: Heading shown when exactly one item page link has been selected (singular form).

wizard_link.description: Column header of the link table in the item-page link data preview.

wizard_loadMore.description: Label for the 'Load more' pagination type in the pagination types tooltip.

wizard_loadingPage.description: Heading shown while the page is loading in the wizard.

wizard_loginFeature.description: A feature bullet in the info card promoting the Advanced Sitemap builder, referring to the extension's log-in feature.

wizard_modifyColumnsBeforeExtracting.description: Instructional text prompting the user to edit columns before extracting data.
wizard_modifyColumnsBeforeExtracting.message: Remove, add or rename columns before extracting

wizard_moreDataExtractors.description: A feature list item in the wizard card promoting the Advanced Sitemap Builder.

wizard_multipleRecordsScraped.description: Heading showing how many records were scraped; the number is a plural count, e.g. '5 records scraped'.

wizard_navigatingPaginationToDiscoverLin.description: Info alert shown in the Sitemap Wizard scrape view while the scraper follows pagination pages before any item records have been scraped.
wizard_navigatingPaginationToDiscoverLin.message: Navigating through pagination to discover item page links.

wizard_nextPage.description: Label for the next-page pagination type option.

wizard_noDataFound.description: an alert message when no data selectors were created because no data was found on the page

wizard_noRecordsScraped.description: Message shown when the scrape finished without collecting any records.
wizard_noRecordsScraped.message: No records were scraped. Check previous steps or retry.

wizard_numberedPages.description: Label for the numbered-pages pagination option, instructing the user to click multiple page buttons.
wizard_numberedPages.message: Numbered pages: click on multiple buttons to select all

wizard_onlyWorksInOneTab.description: Note informing the user that the wizard only works in one tab.

wizard_openDevtools_linuxWindows.description: Instruction shown to Linux and Windows users on how to open the browser's Developer Tools using keyboard shortcuts.
wizard_openDevtools_linuxWindows.message: Press $shortcut1$ or $shortcut2$ to open Developer Tools.

wizard_openDevtools_macos.description: Instruction text showing the macOS keyboard shortcut to open Chrome Developer Tools.

wizard_openDevtools_other.description: Instruction to open the browser's Developer Tools, shown on operating systems without a specific keyboard shortcut.

wizard_paginationDetected.description: Informational text shown when the wizard detects pagination on the page.
wizard_paginationDetected.message: Pagination detected. Manage configuration in the next step.

wizard_paginationEnabled.description: Status title shown when pagination has been enabled for the sitemap.

wizard_pleaseReviewExtension.description: Body text asking the user to review the extension on the browser's webstore.
wizard_pleaseReviewExtension.message: Please review the extension on the browser's webstore!

wizard_rateUs.description: Button that opens the browser store so the user can rate the extension.

wizard_recordsScrapedWithLimit.description: Status text showing total records scraped and how many are shown; both numbers are plurals.

wizard_regenerate.description: A fixed width button that allows to re-generate the data extraction configuration. Previously the configuration was already generated. Should be a single word if possible.

wizard_rescrapeThePage.description: A fixed width button that allows to run the scraping again. Should be a single word if possible.

wizard_reselect.description: A fixed width button that allows to re-select the links with selector tool. Should be a single word if possible.

wizard_retry.description: Button that retries the current step after a failure.

wizard_scheduler.description: A Web Scraper Cloud feature list item, referring to the Scheduler.

wizard_scrapeThePage.description: Button label for starting to scrape the page.

wizard_scraperConfigurationReady.description: Title of a success alert stating the scraper configuration is ready.

wizard_scrapingInProgressMultipleRecords.description: Status text shown while scraping is running; the number of records is a plural.

wizard_scrapingInProgressNoRecord.description: Status text shown while scraping is running before any record is collected.

wizard_scrapingInProgressSingleRecord.description: Heading shown during scraping when a single record has been scraped.

wizard_scrapingInProgressWithLimit.description: Heading shown during scraping with counts; the numbers are plurals, e.g. 'Scraping in progress. (5 records scraped, showing 3)'.
wizard_scrapingInProgressWithLimit.message: Scraping in progress. ($1 records scraped, showing $2)

wizard_scrollingEnabled.description: Card title shown once infinite scroll has been enabled.

wizard_selectAtLeastTwoLinks.description: Warning alert shown when fewer than two links are selected.
wizard_selectAtLeastTwoLinks.message: At least two links are required.

wizard_selectDataPointsManually.description: Info alert shown in the Sitemap Wizard when automatic data extraction failed, suggesting the user selects data points by clicking on the page.

wizard_selectLink.description: Button that starts point-and-click selection of a link on the page.

wizard_selectNextPageButton.description: Button that starts selecting the Next Page pagination button on the page.

wizard_selectPaginationButtonKind.description: Heading of the tooltip listing the common pagination button types to select.
wizard_selectPaginationButtonKind.message: Select pagination button. Common types are:

wizard_sendFeedback.description: A button that sends a single feedback from form.

wizard_showMe.description: Button that opens the Web Scraper tutorial page in a new tab.

wizard_showingLimitedRecords.description: all numbers are plurals, e.g. 'Showing 2 out of 3 records', etc.

wizard_showingRecordsMultiple.description: Heading showing how many records are displayed; the number is a plural, e.g. 'Showing 3 records'.

wizard_showingSingleRecord.description: Heading above the data preview when a single scraped record is shown.

wizard_signUp.description: Button that lets the user sign up for Web Scraper Cloud.

wizard_singleRecordScraped.description: Status text shown when exactly one record has been scraped (singular form).

wizard_sitemapSavedInAdvancedBuilder.description: Alert text confirming the Sitemap has been saved to the Advanced Sitemap Builder.

wizard_skipButton.description: Button that skips the current wizard step when no selection is required, for example skipping item page navigation setup.

wizard_stepDataSetup.description: Label of the Data Setup step in the wizard's step navigation.

wizard_stepFeedbackAndAdvancedScraping.description: Step label in the wizard stepper for the feedback and advanced scraping step.

wizard_stepFollowItemLinks.description: Label of the Follow Item Links step in the wizard's step navigation. Here the user selects links to item pages and the wizard gathers data from each page.

wizard_stepItemPageDataSetup.description: Label of the Item Page Data Setup step in the wizard's step navigation. Here the user is in a single item page and creates data selectors for the data to be scraped from each item page.

wizard_stepPagination.description: Step label in the wizard stepper for the pagination and scroll configuration step.

wizard_thankYouForFeedback.description: Message shown after the user submits feedback.

wizard_title.description: a column name in for link text when showing a table of links with link text and URL. Not a heading title

wizard_trySelectingAgain.description: Button that lets the user select the item page links again.

wizard_weInspectAllReviews.description: Body text explaining that all reviews are inspected to improve the experience.
wizard_weInspectAllReviews.message: All reviews are inspected to improve the user experience.

wizard_yourFeedback.description: A label text in feedback form. It should be in singular form.
